BTC.feeUnit: satoshi per virtual byte for witness paths; exact serializer size otherwise
BTC.wallet: external Bitcoin Core or separately qualified local/SPV signer
BTC.rpc: getblockchaininfo, getblockhash, getrawtransaction/gettxout, listunspent, lockunspent, fundrawtransaction, signrawtransactionwithwallet/qualified external signer, sendrawtransaction (future authorized phases only)
BTC.signature: secp256k1 ECDSA for reviewed legacy/SegWit v0 profile; no automatic Taproot substitution
BTC.special: BTC remains existing regtest scope only

DOGE.feeUnit: integer koinu per 1000 serialized bytes; RPC DOGE/kB must be converted exactly
DOGE.wallet: external Dogecoin 1.14.9 wallet only after separate wallet permission; D1 had no wallet
DOGE.rpc: legacy signrawtransaction, getrawtransaction/gettxout, listunspent, lockunspent, sendrawtransaction plus identity RPC (not authorized now)
DOGE.signature: legacy secp256k1 ECDSA; P2SH; no witness stability assumption
DOGE.special: AuxPoW parsing; CLTV regtest activation height 1351; CSV not qualified

LTC.feeUnit: litoshi per virtual byte / 1000 bytes as explicitly tagged by interface
LTC.wallet: transparent Litecoin Core/SPV profile; MWEB excluded
LTC.rpc: chain/UTXO/funding/signing/broadcast RPCs bound to exact qualified Litecoin version (future approval)
LTC.signature: secp256k1 ECDSA reviewed transparent legacy/SegWit v0 paths only
LTC.special: No MWEB inherited from upstream support

BCH.feeUnit: DCRDEX rate in atomic/byte; BasicSwap covenant branch uses absolute atomic fee, not generic atomic/kB
BCH.wallet: BCHN/Electron Cash profile; exact version/signature policy separately frozen
BCH.rpc: BCHN UTXO/funding/legacy-signing/broadcast and covenant-specific chain validation (future approval)
BCH.signature: ForkID-aware BCH signature hashing; DCRDEX custom signer; BasicSwap BCH covenant/OtVES code is distinct
BCH.special: No SegWit. BasicSwap has_segwit() true is internal routing compatibility, not a consensus statement

XMR.feeUnit: atomic per transaction weight/priority and quantization mask from exact daemon version
XMR.wallet: monerod plus local user-controlled monero-wallet-rpc; shared key material never backend-owned
XMR.rpc: get_height/get_info/get_fee_estimate, refresh, get_transfers, generate_from_keys/import outputs/key images, transfer/sweep (future permissions only)
XMR.signature: Monero ring-signature spend plus cross-curve DLEAG/OtVES protocol; not a Bitcoin HTLC
XMR.special: No script timelock refund; script-side cancellation/refund reveals key share; availability/swipe risk must be audited
